takes.h: A 1408 sequel is in development, with Natalia Dyer and Elijah Wood
takes.p: Dread Central, citing Variety, reports that Natalia Dyer will lead a sequel to the Stephen King adaptation 1408, with Elijah Wood in a supporting role. Mikael Håfström returns to direct a script he co-wrote with Mark Verheiden. John Cusack and Samuel L. Jackson are negotiating returns; production is slated for the first quarter of 2027.
